table.wrong: Not now — follow the pulsing target.

fx.winSub: 3 Gigs — you need 7 at the start of your turn to win

begin.tip: You go second. Click to start the match.
begin.title: Welcome to the table
begin.explain: You go second. Goal: 7 Gigs at the start of your turn. Hover cards (long-press on mobile) to read their text. Next we’ll cover card types and zones.

intro-types.title: 4 card types
intro-types.explain: Unit = crew on the Field (attacks). Program = one-shot effect (often trashed after). Gear = equips a Unit/Legend. Legend = 3 deck characters (left zone). Eddies = money made by selling.

intro-legends.title: Your 3 Legends
intro-legends.explain: They start face-down. Once per turn you can Call a Legend (1 €$) to flip one at random. Face-up or down, a Legend can also pay 1 €$ (like an Eddie).

t1-die.title: Gain a Gig
t1-die.explain: Each turn: Ready → draw → Gig. Take a Fixer die (d20 always last), roll it, put it in your Gig area. 1 die = 1 Gig. The face = Street Cred.

t1-sell.title: Sell → 1 Eddie
t1-sell.explain: Once per turn: sell a card with the sell tag. It goes face-down to Eddies and is always worth 1 €$ (not its printed cost).

t1-play.title: Play a Unit (cost 4)
t1-play.explain: The cost is top-left: Meredith Stout costs 4 €$. Pick her from hand, then pay 4 €$: your Eddie, then your 3 Legends (1 €$ each).

t1-pay-eddie.title: Pay with an Eddie
t1-pay-eddie.explain: Each face-down Eddie is worth 1 €$. Click it to spend (it turns). It readies at the start of your next turn.

t1-pay-legend-1.title: Finish with Legends
t1-pay-legend-1.explain: 3 €$ left. Legends also pay 1 €$ each when spent. Click a Legend.

t1-pay-legend-2.title: Second Legend
t1-pay-legend-2.explain: Another 1 €$ paid. 1 €$ will remain: your last Legend.

t1-pay-legend-3.title: Last €$ → Unit enters
t1-pay-legend-3.explain: Meredith enters your Field ready, but with Lag: without Adrenaline, a Unit can’t attack the turn it’s played. She has Blocker: she can protect your Gigs during the Rival’s turn.

t1-end.title: Pass the turn
t1-end.explain: All your €$ is spent and Meredith has Lag: nothing else to do. End your turn: the Rival then takes their Start and Main phases.

r1-ready.title: Rival Start Phase
r1-ready.explain: Like you, the Rival readies spent cards (their Meredith stands up), draws a card, then takes a Fixer die for a Gig.

r1-gig.title: Rival gains a Gig
r1-gig.explain: They roll a d8 from the Fixer and place an 8 in their Gig area. Each Gig counts toward winning.

r1-play.title: Main Phase — Jackie
r1-play.explain: The Rival pays the cost and plays Jackie Welles (Power 8) onto their Field. She enters ready but with Lag: she can’t attack this turn.

r1-attack.title: Rival Meredith attacks
r1-attack.explain: The Rival spends their Meredith (Power 5), in play since the start of their turn, and targets your Gig area. Your Meredith could block, but 5 vs 5 is a tie: both would go to Trash. You let it through.

r1-steal.title: You lose a Gig
r1-steal.explain: Successful Gig attack: one die moves from your area to the Rival’s (Power 5 → 1 Gig stolen).

t2-die.title: Start Phase (Turn 2)
t2-die.explain: Ready (cards upright) + draw + new Gig. Click the d8: the d20 is always last.

t2-sell.title: Program → Eddie
t2-sell.explain: Detonate is a Program: in a real game you can also play it for its effect (then Trash). Here we sell it for 1 Eddie — you’ll have 2 Eddies to pay for Gear.

t2-gear.title: Equip Gear
t2-gear.explain: Adrenaline Converter costs 2 €$ and gives +3 Power to the Unit carrying it. Click the Gear, then pay with your 2 Eddies.

t2-gear-pay-1.title: Eddies first
t2-gear-pay-1.explain: Usually spend Eddies before Legends. Click a ready Eddie.

t2-gear-pay-2.title: Gear on Meredith
t2-gear-pay-2.explain: The Gear attaches to Meredith: Power 5 + 3 = 8. It follows her if she moves zones.

t2-call-pay.title: Call a Legend (once/turn)
t2-call-pay.explain: Your Eddies are spent but your 3 Legends are ready. Spend one (1 €$) to Call a Legend: flip a Legend face-up without peeking.

t2-call-flip.title: Flip a Legend
t2-call-flip.explain: The Legend flips face-up. Resolve its {Call} effects. It can still pay 1 €$ later.

t2-end.title: End of Turn 2
t2-end.explain: Meredith could attack, but she’d stay spent during the Rival’s turn. Keep her ready: with Blocker and 8 Power, she protects your Gigs.

r2-ready.title: Rival Start Phase
r2-ready.explain: New Rival turn: their Meredith readies again. Jackie stayed ready, so she couldn’t be attacked.

r2-gig.title: Rival gains a Gig
r2-gig.explain: They draw, then roll a d4 from the Fixer: a 4 joins their Gig area.

r2-attack.title: Attack on your Gigs
r2-attack.explain: Rival Meredith (Power 5) spends and targets your Gig area. You can react with a ready Blocker — your Meredith!

r2-block.title: Blocker reaction
r2-block.explain: Spend Meredith to redirect the attack onto her. Fight: 8 (5 + Gear) vs 5, the Rival’s Meredith goes to Trash. No Gig is stolen — this is your key defense.

t3-die.title: Turn 3 — new Gig
t3-die.explain: Ready → draw → Gig. Meredith, your Eddies and your Legends are ready again.

t3-play.title: An Adrenaline Unit
t3-play.explain: Riding Nomad costs 5 €$: your 2 Eddies + your 3 Legends. It has Adrenaline: it can attack this very turn. Click Nomad.

t3-pay-eddie-2.title: Second Eddie
t3-pay-eddie-2.explain: Your 2nd Eddie pays another 1 €$. 3 €$ left to pay with your Legends.

t3-pay-legend-1.title: Then Legends
t3-pay-legend-1.explain: Face-up or down, each Legend pays 1 €$. Click a Legend.

t3-pay-legend-2.title: 1 €$ to go
t3-pay-legend-2.explain: Another 1 €$ paid. One last Legend and Nomad enters.

t3-pay-legend-3.title: Nomad enters
t3-pay-legend-3.explain: Paid. Thanks to Adrenaline, Nomad ignores Lag: it can attack right away.

t3-atk-select.title: Declare the attacker
t3-atk-select.explain: To attack, spend a ready Unit (turn it). Target: a spent rival Unit, or the rival Gig area. Jackie is ready, so she can’t be attacked: go for the Gigs.

t3-atk-target.title: Steal a Gig
t3-atk-target.explain: Attacking the Gig area steals dice: Power 1+ → 1 Gig, 10+ → 2, 20+ → 3. Nomad (P4) steals 1 Gig. A real game continues until 7 Gigs at the start of your turn.

done.title: You’ve got the basics
done.explain: You’ve seen: types (Unit/Program/Gear/Legend), Eddies, costs, Lag and Adrenaline, Call a Legend, attack, Blocker, fights, Gear. For RAM, deckbuilding and all keywords → Detailed rules.
